notes.title: New Upcoming Game: The Shivers
notes.content:
Dear Players! We're proud to announce The Shivers: Metaphysical Intelligence! A first-person horror ghost investigation game. Created with the cutting-edge [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b] technology, the game will support Ray Tracing, HDR effect, 4K resolution, and make use of the Lumen system to offer the most immersive and visceral horror experience.
You will be able to talk to the ghost and the environment, develop your character and safe house and enjoy different experience in each game you play with your friends.

We invite you to join the new community on Steam. Add The Shivers to your wishlist today and stay up to date with the latest news about the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929610/The_Shivers

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27974450/bf4947e8caf83e96c51c5ed826d8e57794211a41.jpg[/img]

We told you the news that the month we passed "No70: Eye of Basir" has been postponed. As a result of this delay, we have stated that you have optimization problems. And Your good approach has made us very happy. 

We solved the optimization problems and made the game ready. We started playing the game as a team. However, due to some problems in overseas negotiations, we have to ask you to wait for 20 more days. 

Our beta tests are very positive and stable, we have solved all kinds of technical problems. While you were waiting for this process, we also published a new trailer. We look forward to June 28th and thank you very much for your support. We would like to state at least as exciting as you are. We're on Steam on June 28th.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9NobMBLj5xM&feature=youtu.be] For Trailer Link	[/url]

notes.title: About VR
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27974450/bf4947e8caf83e96c51c5ed826d8e57794211a41.jpg[/img]

We had announced that No70: Eye of Basir Will come with the VR support ... But we want you to know we could not get exactly the performance we wanted from the VR version of the game. For this reason; VR version of the game will released in beta mode

What is the mean VR Beta Mode ?

We can explain this as an experimental phase of the game, With the release of the game, VR will be working. But we have to say that this is the most experimental work we have done before. Some parts of the game may not work as stable. And we hope to be able to correct such errors with feedback from you. Thank you for supporting us !!
